claims.claim: Atlas20's candidate pool combines a current ranking, an explicit legacy list and previously onboarded cache. Historical coins never collected remain outside this evidence.
claims.next_requirement: An independently versioned historical universe with as-of publication and identity records.

claims.support: fixed-source formula plus independent synthetic counterexample and mathematical/pandas review
claims.claim: The retrospective price cleaner can change admission of a past row when only later prices change.
claims.next_requirement: Correction first-known time and revision vintages, followed by a causal replay; real return impact is unmeasured.

claims.claim: CSCV splits overlap; candidate-column trial counts do not establish a complete research ledger. Walk-forward stitching of candidate return paths does not reconstruct switched holdings and cash.
claims.next_requirement: Bind all trial choices, input vintages, fixed-primary inference and switch accounting before treating results as independent validation.

claims.claim: The research text calls cost settings round-trip totals, while the engine charges the setting against one-way L1 notional. A full switch has two units of turnover.
claims.next_requirement: Reconcile cost units before comparison; this discrepancy alone establishes no direction of performance error.

claims.claim: LTT's turtle and RSI alerts use distinct sources and bar references, and each timeframe is scanned separately. The reviewed paths do not specify a complete position, exit, shorting, fee or order policy.
claims.next_requirement: A faithful economic specification and source/bar-close alignment; any single-source daily subset must be labeled a new experiment.

claims.support: official public JavaScript component instrument review
claims.claim: WWCloud's catalogue UI maps several transport, HTTP, JSON and catalogue-format exceptions into one generic error state.
claims.next_requirement: Actual request diagnosis, supported model entitlement and gateway prices; the observed message alone does not prove invalid credentials.

scope: Source audit and independently checked synthetic mechanism only; not author-performance reproduction, execution readiness or a substitute for the original research programme.
